scope.clock: Date.now controlled before service construction and advanced only by trusted test IPC; real index PIDs terminate and reopen the same SQLite file
scope.transport: local deterministic model response only; global fetch guard prevents unregistered external effects
scope.startup: fixture-only isolated execution bypass is cleared before production singleton import
scope.boundaries: actual stop/restart at fireAt−1/equality/+1 and SLA−1/equality/+1; equality classifier recover but no dispatch retry window
limitations: Controlled clock boundaries are deterministic; this is not wall-clock scheduler punctuality or real provider behavior.
Source ownerAuth, member identity, malformed baseline and Action generation drift are separately covered in waits.json.
